name: product-demo-infrastructure
summary: Imports the upstream Infrastructure Product Demo template without launching it.

lifecycle.idempotency: Reuses Product Demos base resources and reconciles the owned setup template.
lifecycle.failure_boundary: Stops before template creation when AAP or Product Demos base resources are unavailable.

readiness: The owned Infrastructure template is present in AAP and has not been launched.

security.secret_storage: Cloud, broker, and managed-host credentials are not collected by the import.
security.network_trust: AAP and pinned Product Demos content retain configured trust controls.
security.external_actions: No cloud, broker, managed host, or demo job is created automatically.
